summary: FAIL. The DG2 candidate is largely faithful to the playbook. All required checks pass on Node 22 and 24, and on a live stack I observed G1 and G2 (and, through the browser journey, G3) business decisions with sequential phase advance in EN and AR. One mandatory acceptance criterion is unmet: REQ-PB-031/B0041 'Are explicit exclusions documented?' never fails. An empty Out of scope gives 'unknown', and whitespace-only gives 'pass' (F-DG2-150, Medium, mandatory). There are also two Low findings: duplicated gate codes in the gate titles (F-DG2-151) and a register API path that does not exist (F-DG2-152).
